title: Khoon Bhari Maang
desc: Widowed Aarti falls prey to Sanjay's vicious plan of getting married to him. Later, with the help of her best friend Nandini, he drowns Aarti and seizes her wealth, but she survives and seeks revenge.

title: Phool Aur Kaante
desc: Love leads Ajay down a new path when he is expected to inherit his father's criminal empire, bringing along perils that could either tear their family apart or solidify their bond.

title: Hamara Dil Aapke Paas Hai
desc: When Preeti stands up against a murderer in court, she suffers a devastating consequence. Later, after being rejected by her loved ones, she finds shelter and support in an empathetic stranger.

title: Pralay the Destroyer
desc: Some thugs annihilate an entire family and flee the scene without facing any consequences. Years later, the universe balances the scales of justice through the sole survivor of the tragedy.

title: Judaai
desc: Lured by wealth, Kajal asks her husband, Raj, an honest engineer, to get married to Janhvi, the rich daughter of his boss. Little does she know about the problems that await her.
